name: Sign on to MERIDIAN CORE
goal: Sign on to the MERIDIAN CORE credit-union servicing console using the given operator ID and password (select a branch if the sign-on screen asks for one), and reach the member-servicing home/menu screen. Confirm the signed-in operator's role is shown somewhere on the landing screen.

outputs.name: landing_screen
outputs.description: Name/title of the screen reached after sign-on (proves session is active).

business_outcomes.description: Bad operator ID or password — a legitimate rejection, not a system failure.

known_interstitials.description: Unexpected maintenance interstitial shown during/after sign-on.
